instruction: Bring back the last browser tab that was closed.

metadata.explanation: Task variation using developer-related websites (github.com, stackoverflow.com, gitlab.com). User needs to restore the just-closed tab (gitlab.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator checks if all 3 tabs are open using the existing is_expected_tabs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter get_open_tabs_info (chrome.py:623-707) correctly extracts all open tabs with their URLs
Metric is_expected_tabs (chrome.py:120-140) correctly compares expected URLs with actual URLs using order-independent matching via are_lists_equal
Expected values correctly specify all 3 URLs (github.com, stackoverflow.com, gitlab.com) that should be present after restoration
Complete coverage: evaluator checks that all 3 tabs are open, which fully verifies the instruction requirement
Tab order independence: are_lists_equal uses any() to find matching elements regardless of position, so restored tab position doesn't affect verification
No edge case issues: if tab restore fails, gitlab.com won't be in the list and evaluator will correctly return 0
